sma-crossover.title: SMA Crossover
sma-crossover.subtitle: Dual Moving Average System
entryRules: Enter long when fast SMA crosses above slow SMA with ADX > 20
Enter short when fast SMA crosses below slow SMA with ADX > 20
exitRules: Exit when fast SMA crosses back against position direction
Exit if price closes beyond ATR trailing stop
riskRules: Trail stop at 2x ATR from highest close since entry
Close if cross reverses within 3 bars of entry

stage0.title: Market Regime
conditions: Determine trend direction via SMA slope
Confirm regime with price above/below long SMA
Filter flat regimes where SMA slope is near zero

stage1.title: Signal Detection
conditions: Fast SMA crosses above slow SMA for long
Fast SMA crosses below slow SMA for short
Require minimum separation between SMAs after cross

stage2.title: Confirmation
conditions: Price closes in the direction of the cross
Volume exceeds 20-period average on cross bar
ADX above 20 confirms trending environment

stage3.title: Execution
conditions: Enter at market on confirmed cross
Place initial stop at recent swing opposite the entry
Size position to risk no more than 1% of equity

stage4.title: Risk Control
conditions: Trail stop using ATR multiple from price
Exit if fast SMA flattens or reverses slope
Close position if cross reverses within 3 bars

macd-trend.title: MACD Trend
macd-trend.subtitle: MACD Signal Line System
entryRules: Enter long on MACD crossing above signal line with histogram positive
Enter short on MACD crossing below signal line with histogram negative
exitRules: Exit when MACD crosses signal line against position
Exit if histogram contracts for two consecutive bars
riskRules: Initial stop at 1.5x ATR from entry
Reduce position if MACD approaches zero line against trend

stage0.title: Market Regime
conditions: Identify trend using MACD line position relative to zero
Confirm regime with histogram expansion
Filter regimes where histogram oscillates near zero

stage1.title: Signal Detection
conditions: MACD line crosses above signal line for long
MACD line crosses below signal line for short
Histogram turns positive/negative confirming momentum

stage2.title: Confirmation
conditions: Price is above/below 50-period EMA matching signal direction
Histogram bar is larger than previous bar
Volume confirms directional commitment

stage3.title: Execution
conditions: Enter at market on confirmed MACD signal line cross
Set initial stop at recent swing level
Size to 1% equity risk per trade

stage4.title: Risk Control
conditions: Exit on MACD signal line cross in opposite direction
Trail stop using histogram decline as warning
Close if histogram reverses for two consecutive bars

donchian-channel.title: Donchian Channel
donchian-channel.subtitle: Channel Breakout System

Enter short when price closes below 20-period lower channel
exitRules: Exit when price reaches mid-channel level

stage0.title: Market Regime
conditions: Measure channel width to gauge volatility

stage1.title: Signal Detection
conditions: Price breaks above upper channel for long
Price breaks below lower channel for short

stage2.title: Confirmation

stage4.title: Risk Control
